summary: Kit: magic circle in the magic shop too
author: pm
body:
User, 2026-11-24, in chat: "Yes, add it" (asked whether the magic shop should get the HH-0071 magic circle too). The magic shop (sources/client/dialog_box_magic_shop.cpp, 304x328, converted in HH-0066 batch 4) had the same hexagram baked into its old background (Game4 frame 1).

Draw the kit frame magic_circle there, centred where the old hexagram's centre was (measured from the sprite), after the background and before the content. Skip it if the frame is missing.

**Done when:** a bridge screenshot shows the circle behind the spell list at the measured place, both builds are clean, and the review passes.

Source: chat, 2026-11-24.
